drafts.title: Hypothetical Time-to-First-Token Comparison: Setup A vs. Setup B
drafts.body: This post discusses a hypothetical time-to-first-token (TTFT) comparison between two local LLM setups, labeled A and B. The hypothetical experiment suggests Setup A achieves a TTFT of 1.2 seconds, while Setup B hypothetically takes 2.4 seconds. Crucially, both hypothetical runs are stated to use identical prompts and hardware configurations, aiming to isolate the TTFT variable. It's important to note that this is purely a hypothetical scenario based on provided synthetic experimental input. No actual measurements for throughput, accuracy, or statistical uncertainty were part of the hypothetical data. Therefore, these figures should not be interpreted as real-world benchmarks or personal experiences. The focus remains strictly on the reported hypothetical TTFT difference under controlled, albeit simulated, conditions.
